note.zh-CN: 当前面向微信小程序；安装后按框架配置构建适配器。
note.en: Currently targets WeChat mini-apps; configure the build adapter for your framework after installation.

proof.zh-CN: 运行时：从 weapp-stylex 导入官方 create、attrs / props 与主题 API。
proof.en: Runtime: import official create, attrs / props, and theme APIs from weapp-stylex.

proof.zh-CN: 构建：按宿主选择 /weapp-vite、/taro 或 /uni-app 适配器，输出 stylex.wxss。
proof.en: Build: choose the /weapp-vite, /taro, or /uni-app adapter to emit stylex.wxss.

proof.zh-CN: 平台边界：微信主包与普通分包；watch 保证完整重建，不提供 stateful HMR。
proof.en: Scope: WeChat main packages and ordinary subpackages; watch supports complete rebuilds, without stateful HMR.

zh-CN.name: weapp-stylex
zh-CN.tagline: 把官方 StyleX 编译为微信小程序 WXSS
zh-CN.description: 沿用官方 StyleX runtime 与样式合并 API，通过构建适配器输出 WXSS。支持原生 Page/Component、Wevu、Taro React / Vue 3 和 uni-app Vue 3；当前范围限微信小程序。
zh-CN.audience: 希望在微信小程序中使用 StyleX 共享样式、条件合并与主题的原生或跨端团队。
useCases: 在原生微信与 Wevu 中编译 StyleX 样式
在 Taro React / Vue 3 与 uni-app Vue 3 中输出微信 WXSS
跨模块共享样式、tokens、主题与动态值
capabilities: 官方 attrs() / props() 样式合并
原生、Wevu、Taro 与 uni-app 构建适配
WXSS 输出与 watch 完整重建

faqs.question: weapp-stylex 支持哪些平台？
faqs.answer: 当前支持微信主包、页面、组件和普通分包。原生、Wevu、Taro React / Vue 3 和 uni-app Vue 3 有对应适配器；独立分包、其他平台、Vue 2 和 uni-app x 尚未覆盖。

faqs.question: 如何安装并选择构建入口？
faqs.answer: 安装 weapp-stylex 后，根入口提供官方 runtime；按框架使用 weapp-stylex/weapp-vite、weapp-stylex/taro 或 weapp-stylex/uni-app。还需配置对应宿主版本与适配器，详见官方指南。

en.name: weapp-stylex
en.tagline: Compile official StyleX to WeChat WXSS
en.description: Keep the official StyleX runtime and style merging APIs while build adapters emit WXSS. Supports native Page/Component, Wevu, Taro React / Vue 3, and uni-app Vue 3, currently targeting WeChat mini-apps.
en.audience: Native and cross-platform teams using shared StyleX styles, conditional merging, and themes in WeChat mini-apps.
useCases: Compile StyleX in native WeChat and Wevu projects
Emit WeChat WXSS from Taro React / Vue 3 and uni-app Vue 3
Share styles, tokens, themes, and dynamic values across modules
capabilities: Native, Wevu, Taro, and uni-app adapters
WXSS output and complete watch rebuilds

faqs.question: Which platforms does weapp-stylex support?
faqs.answer: The current scope is WeChat main packages, pages, components, and ordinary subpackages. Adapters cover native projects, Wevu, Taro React / Vue 3, and uni-app Vue 3. Independent subpackages, other platforms, Vue 2, and uni-app x are not covered yet.

faqs.question: How do I install and choose an adapter?
faqs.answer: Install weapp-stylex for the official runtime at the root entry. Select weapp-stylex/weapp-vite, weapp-stylex/taro, or weapp-stylex/uni-app for your framework, then configure the supported host version and adapter using the official guide.
